Ran 47 commands, read memory, shared files
This is phase 14a: dialogs, the map search result, and the second hand fix. The tarball contains only the 16 changed files and unpacks at the repository root. No files need deleting, so there is no git rm this time. I couldn’t compile this here because the Android SDK isn’t reachable from my sandbox, so CI on your next push is the first real build.

Why the second hand disappeared: the second needle was the only hand sized with Modifier.height(...) instead of Modifier.size(...). Compose then drew the 24dp vector at its natural size, about 24dp, in the middle of the face, hidden under the hub. The needle picker dialog used size, which is why it looked fine there. It now uses the same size as the hour and minute hands.

Another defect fixed: the empty trail picture had the same problem. It was drawn at 24dp in the middle of a full-width box, and now it scales to the width.

Phase 14a changes:

Dialogs: each panel now stores a small PanelDialog value (for example ClockDialog.Needles or GpsDialog.Target) and draws it in DialogContent. Before, it stored a composable lambda that captured stale values.
Map search result: the result now goes back through the previous screen’s saved state instead of a callback kept in the activity. If you rotate or the app is killed while searching, the result still reaches the GPS target dialog, which reopens itself filled in. The directions editor and custom location form get it the same way.
Sub screens: they now use collectAsStateWithLifecycle, so they stop collecting while in the background.
Tests: added a round-trip test for how the search result is stored, malformed-input cases, and an updated dialog host test.
README: phase 14a is marked done and 14b is next.
Phase 14b (next): moving the panels’ state into view models, collected with collectAsStateWithLifecycle. It’s large enough to deserve its own release, the same way phases 8 to 10 were split.
